1. Main Results

1.1. Riemann-Roch Type Theorems

Theorem 1.1 (Riemann–Roch).

Let X be a smooth projective variety. Then the Euler characteristic satisfies a Riemann-Roch type formula.

Proof.

We apply the Grothendieck-Riemann-Roch theorem. The key computation involves the Todd class and the Chern character. By standard arguments in algebraic geometry, the result follows.

The proof is complete.

Theorem 1.2.

For any coherent sheaf ℱ on X, we have a long exact sequence in cohomology.

Proof.

This follows from the derived functor long exact sequence applied to the short exact sequence of sheaves. Standard homological algebra completes the argument.

QED.
